messages:
sam: Deploy-bot kicked off v2 rollout to prod canary at 5% traffic. change window 14:00-16:00 UTC. enable trace-sampling=0.5 and 1h retention on canary metrics. cc @ops @sre

deploy-bot: [automated] v2 rollout started. canary=5%. routes: /v2/* -> v2-canary cluster. check dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rollouts/v2-canary

lee: Quick ask — did we set header-gate fallback? clients that can't handle v2 should get `X-API-Version: v1` behavior still, right?

maria: Yes, header-gate is active. If `X-Prefer-Version: v1` present we route to v1. That config is part of the canary policy.

jessica: Noting: mobile SDK team requested a pin-by-client for the first hour. We can add IP-based exception list if needed.

rahul: I see a small error bump in model-serving latency on one host (p50 from 120ms->200ms) but p95 is still okay. Tagging @ops to watch.

ops: Investigating now — looks like one GPU node on cluster-a is showing CPU steal. draining it from canary pool; fallback will re-balance.

ci-cd-bot: CI checks for rollout passed. Release notes draft: https://notion.redwood/company/releases/v2-canary-1930043210 - includes migration notes and client compatibility table.

sam: OK if we hold at 5% for 20 minutes and check errors/latency and any client telemetry? If silent, we plan 25% at 14:30 UTC.

maria: +1. Can everyone post any client breakages in this thread only. If we need to stop, we do immediate pause and revert traffic to v1.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary metrics snapshot: errors 0.3% (baseline 0.1%), token-timeout spikes 0.05%, avg latency +12ms. Threshold for auto-pause: errors >1% OR token-timeout >0.4%

lee: Errors look fine but the delta is higher than expected. I'd rather gate the 25% push until the GPU node drain completes.

ops: Drain finished. all hosts healthy. rolling rebalance completed at 14:12 UTC.

sam: Thanks. Proceeding to 25% now. watchful for 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: [automated] traffic shifted to 25%. canary=25%.

rahul: Seeing new client error reports from PaymentService SDK v1.2 — stacktrace points to strict schema check in v2 responses (missing field). Are we supposed to add backward-compatible field?

jessica: PaymentService is on our compatibility list. This is a regression. Rollback plan: --fast-revert route to v1 for affected clients OR apply server-side compatibility shim to include legacy field. Which is faster?

lee: Server shim might take ~30-60m to implement & test. Fast-revert can be executed in <5m with route pin. Recommend revert for affected clients + follow-up shim.

sam: Agreed. Identify client IDs or IPs, roll them back. Use admin route override: `POST /admin/route/override {"client_id":"<id>","route":"v1"}`.

ops: Running revert for client group `payments-prod` now.

deploy-bot: [automated] override applied for payments-prod, routed to v1. Effective immediately. traffic to v2 reduced by ~3%

rahul: Payments errors dropped to baseline after revert. Good catch.

maria: We should update release notes and add a compatibility note: v2 will include an optional `legacy_amount_cents` field for at least 3 releases. Action item: @jessica take lead on shim and merge within next day.

jessica: On it. I'll open PR and link tests to the rollout checklist.

sam: Closing loop — continue to monitor for the rest of the window. If anything crosses auto-pause threshold, we stop and run full rollback. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
